turns.text: Jack stammered slightly, attempting to recall any suitable accomplishment of Lady Bloxham’s. turns.speaker: Lady Bracknell

turns.speaker: Gwendolen

turns.speaker: Lady Bracknell
turns.text: Lady Bracknell regarded Miss Fairfax with a look of profound, if thinly veiled, exasperation, then turned her attention once more to Mr. Worthing. turns.speaker: Gwendolen
turns.text: Gwendolen interrupted again, her tone sharp with a hint of theatrical offense. turns.speaker: Lady Bracknell
turns.text: Lady Bracknell regarded Miss Fairfax with a look of palpable weariness, then addressed Mr. Worthing with a sigh that suggested the weight of generations of social responsibility. turns.speaker: Gwendolen

turns.speaker: Lady Bracknell

turns.text: Lady Bracknell raised a hand, silencing Mr. Worthing’s further effusions regarding the deceased Mr. Hobbs. turns.speaker: Lady Bracknell

turns.speaker: Jack
